{{Top|leg}}
The '''Model 608 Mega'puter''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] produced by [[Neuro-Saav Corporation|NeuroSaav]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
A large number of Model 608 Mega'puters were installed in [[Gopsthal]], the main administrative district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Woostri/Legends|Woostri]]. As a result, much of the planet became computer-controlled. Everything from [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] maintenance to traffic control to housekeeping was [[Droid/Legends|droid]]- or computer-directed, and as a result [[Woostoid]]s had a large amount of free time.
